name: Tenma Mitsuru
source:
He loves running a lot, so Mitsuru has developed the habit of running around with no regard for time and place. He loves bread too. While he's innocent and no good with his studies, his keen senses allow him to quickly pick up on the essence of a situation. His singing voice is as if it's bursting through, and he puts his all into making his performances powerful.

Affiliated with RHYTHM LINK’s Ra*bits.

[From in-game profile]
